definitions.explanation: A tool powered by electricity or a battery, such as a drill, saw, or sander, as opposed to a hand tool.

examples.japanese: {電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}を{使|つか}うときは{安全|あんぜん}に{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: Be careful about safety when using power tools.

examples.japanese: DIYを{始|はじ}めるなら、まず{基本的|きほんてき}な{電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}を{揃|そろ}えよう。
examples.english: If you're starting DIY, first put together a basic set of power tools.

examples.japanese: ホームセンターでは{電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}のレンタルサービスもあるので、{買|か}わなくても{気軽|きがる}に{使|つか}える。
examples.english: Home improvement stores also offer power tool rental services, so you can easily use them without buying.

notes:
A compound of {電動|でんどう} (electric-powered) and {工具|こうぐ} (tool, implement). DIY ({日曜大工|にちようだいく}) culture has grown significantly in Japan, making this a practical everyday term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}セット: power tool set
- {充電式|じゅうでんしき}{電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}: rechargeable power tool
- {電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}を{使|つか}いこなす: to master using power tools
- {電動工具|でんどうこうぐ}{売|う}り{場|ば}: power tools section (of a store)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手工具|てこうぐ}: hand tool — tools operated by hand without a motor
- {工具|こうぐ}: tool — the general term for any tool or implement
- {電動|でんどう}ドリル: electric drill — one common type of power tool
